C.lawCode: Add §160.57, CP L; amd §§845-d, 296 & 837-n, Exec L; amd §212, Judy L; amd §9, Cor L; add §50-g, Civ Rts L

summary: Provides for automatic sealing of certain convictions after a certain passage of time from either imposition of sentence, release from parole or probation, and if the defendant does not have a current charge pending; excludes certain offenses; permits access by certain persons.
title: Relates to the automatic sealing of certain convictions
